0.0: One of the most important qualities of a Sand Bandit is selflessness. True, Sand Bandits steal riches from the queen, but it's not for us. It's for the people of #m260000000#.
0.1: A selfish individual cannot contain his greed. He will inevitably want to keep the expensive items for himself. This is taboo for a Sand Bandit. Thus, I must test how selfless you really are

yes.0: It's simple. I need you to donate #b10,000 mesos#k. Too much? Think about it, we'll need much more than that to save #m260000000# from the queen. Selflessly part with 10,000 mesos, and I will believe in you.

no.0: You've done well so far. Don't falter now... Then again, it is hard to let go of mesos...

1.0: You've decided to donate 10,000 mesos? I am sure there was much you could have bought with that money, yet you selflessly sacrificed it for the people of #m260000000#. That's commendable.

yes.0: Then you have passed the tests that I, #p2101011#, have for you. Now you just have to earn the trust of the other Sand Bandits hidden around town. Keep at it.

item.0: That's not enough. #b10,000 mesos#k shouldn't be hard to obtain.

QuestInfo.0: You've passed all of #p2101011#'s tests. Right? Hm, maybe you should talk it over with #b#p2101011##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2101011# needs you to fork over #b10000 mesos#k to help the Sand Bandits give aid to the people of #m260000000#. He says selflessness is a key trait for a Sand Bandit.
